title: Ahead of the Moment: Celebrating 125 Years of Limbach
summary: Meet our esteemed guests (1:20) on this very special season 5 finale; all three have played an integral role in rebranding Limbach to be who we are today. In this episode, we hear from Katie Massie, Director of Marketing; Matt Katz, EVP Mergers, Acquisitions, & Capital Markets; and Jay Sharp, Regional President of the Midwest and Northeast. Meet our esteemed guests (1:20) on this very special season 5 finale; all three have played an integral role in rebranding Limbach to be who we are today. In this episode, we hear from Katie Massie, Director of Marketing; Matt Katz, EVP Mergers, Acquisitions, & Capital Markets; and Jay Sharp, Regional President of the Midwest and Northeast. We talk about the stories and values from 1901 to now (6:39) that have shaped how we serve customers. And importantly, we discuss how Limbach’s evolved identity (13:30) has an impact for our investors, customers, and current as well as new employees. So to understand the future of Limbach and your part in it (27:00), tune into this episode and explore the resilience, adaptability, and focus it takes to not just survive 125 years, but truly thrive.
